(Image: Wikimediacommons) CAT Admit Card 2026 Link : The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore has issued the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admit card today, November 6. CAT admit card 2026 link is now available on the official website, which had been removed earlier. Candidates can access the CAT admit card download link through the website at iimcat.ac.in.

 The CAT admit card 2026 can be downloaded using the application login ID and password. IIM Indore had earlier revised the CAT 2026 admit card release date from November 4 to November 6. According to the latest announcement, the CAT 2026 admit cards for all eligible candidates have been generated and will remain available for download until November 29, the examination date.
 Along with the admit card, the CAT 2026 mock test will also be made available on the official website from November 6. The CAT mock test 2026 will help candidates familiarise themselves with the examination interface and question format before the entrance test.

 How to download CAT admit card 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to download the CAT 2026 admit card:
 Visit the official website, iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the Registered Candidate Login link.
 Enter the CAT 2026 user ID and password.
 Open the CAT admit card download link on the candidate dashboard.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Download the CAT admit card PDF.
 Take a clear printout of the admit card for examination day.
 CAT 2026 exam date and timings
 IIM Indore will conduct CAT 2026 on November 29 in three shifts. The examination will be held in computer-based test (CBT) mode. The three examination sessions are:
 Shift
 Exam timing
 Slot 1
 8:30 am to 10:30 am
 Slot 2
 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm
 Slot 3
 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm
 Candidates should check their allotted examination slot and reporting time on their CAT 2026 admit card.
 IIMs have introduced additional security measures for CAT 2026 to prevent malpractice during the examination. These include face matching and the deployment of mobile jammers at select examination centres.
